name: Hammamet

queries.query: Hammamet Tunisia cadastral map parcel official geospatial viewer cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Tunisian OTC cadastral geoportal and the Nabeul/Zaghouan regional OTC office. The official geoportal page describes a cadastral information project, but no public anonymous parcel feature service or downloadable Hammamet parcel layer was exposed in the checked pages.

queries.query: cadastre parcellaire Hammamet Tunisie carte officielle
queries.result: La recherche officielle en français a retrouvé le Géoportail cadastral de l’Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre et le bureau régional OTC Nabeul/Zaghouan. Aucun service public anonyme donnant un identifiant de parcelle et une géométrie pour Hammamet n’a été trouvé dans les pages vérifiées.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: The official Nabeul governorate directory identifies the Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre Nabeul/Zaghouan in Nabeul; the governorate municipal directory identifies Hammamet municipality. Neither publishes an open parcel layer in the checked material.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreAuthority: Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre (OTC), under Tunisia’s Ministry of Equipment and Housing.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: The OTC first-party geoportal page explicitly describes cadastral information management, dissemination and regional structures; the first-party Nabeul directory identifies the regional OTC office. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not adapter qualification or citywide geometry coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A first-party national cadastre authority, a Nabeul regional OTC office, and first-party Hammamet municipal context were evidenced.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The current OTC geoportail HTML was fetched anonymously and its scripts/configuration were inspected. It is a descriptive project page with ordinary HTML and image content; no cadastral map iframe, OGC endpoint, ArcGIS endpoint, parcel API, native fields, CRS declaration, or ID-plus-geometry response was exposed. No guessed endpoint was treated as a source response.
